name: Steps
description: Numbered steps in a row or a column: the current step is highlighted, earlier ones are ticked. Good for tutorials, onboarding and processes.

params.name: steps
params.help: Up to 8 step names, in order, short (one to three words each)

params.name: current
params.help: The step in progress, 1-based (0: none). Earlier steps are shown ticked

params.name: layout
params.help: horizontal: a row (wide, low box); vertical: a column (tall box, give it a taller rect)
